svg.title: Moog Matriarch connections
svg.desc: Connection inventory. Arrows indicate signal direction relative to the instrument. Locations identify hardware faces; the diagram is not a socket placement drawing. Physical control sections are listed below.
svg.metadata: Symbol vocabulary: NYU ABILITY Project / IDM SynthAccess; https://github.com/IDMNYU/synthaccess/tree/ee1ef12cec3a3fb6be59a7861f7df8848be2dafe/tactileSynthGuides. Original schematic geometry; physical controls do not imply MIDI mappings.
svg.text: Moog Matriarch / CONNECTIONS
Arrows are relative to the device. Locations name the hardware face; sockets are grouped by function.

svg.text: DATA / POWER / CONTROLS
PHYSICAL CONTROLS / see interface.svg for labelled positions
MODULATION PATCH: Rate IN, Wave OUT, S/H OUT
UTILITIES PATCH: IN, OUT
OSC 1 PATCH: Pitch IN, PWM IN, Wave OUT
OSC 2 PATCH: Pitch IN, PWM IN, Wave OUT
OSC 3 PATCH: Pitch IN, PWM IN, Wave OUT
OSC 4 PATCH: Pitch IN, PWM IN, Wave OUT
MIXER PATCH: Osc IN, Noise IN, OUT
FILTERS PATCH: Audio IN, Cutoff IN, OUT
ENVELOPES PATCH: Trigger IN, Env OUT
OUTPUT PATCH: Delay IN, Delay OUT
ARP / SEQ: Rate, Mode, Octave, Hold, Play, Tap, Glide
MODULATION: Rate, Waveform, Pitch amt, Cutoff amt, PWM amt
UTILITIES: Attenuator 1, Attenuator 2
OSC 1: Octave, Waveform
OSC 2: Octave, Waveform, Frequency, Sync
OSC 3: Octave, Waveform, Frequency, Sync
OSC 4: Octave, Waveform, Frequency, Sync
MIXER: Osc 1, Osc 2, Noise, Osc 3, Osc 4
FILTERS: Cutoff, Resonance, Env amt, KB track, Spacing, Resonance 2, Mode
ENVELOPES: Attack, Decay, Sustain, Release, Amp attack, Amp decay, Amp sustain, Amp release
OUTPUT: Volume, Delay time L, Delay time R, Feedback, Mix
PERFORMANCE: Pitch, Mod
